question: What is the median of the average monthly projected sales in USD for France in 2021, calculated by using the monthly sales data from 2019 and 2020 (filtered by promo_total_id=1 and channel_total_id=1), applying the growth rate from 2019 to 2020 to project 2021, converting to USD based on the currency table, and then determining the monthly averages before finding their median?

-- Final query with proper rounding
WITH monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.time_id) as yr,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.time_id) as mo,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'France'
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.time_id) IN (2019, 2020)
    GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.time_id), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.time_id)
),
sales_2019 AS (
    SELECT mo, total_sales as sales_2019 FROM monthly_sales WHERE yr = 2019
),
sales_2020 AS (
    SELECT mo, total_sales as sales_2020 FROM monthly_sales WHERE yr = 2020
),
projected AS (
    SELECT 
        s2019.mo,
        (((s2020.sales_2020 - s2019.sales_2019) / s2019.sales_2019) * s2020.sales_2020) + s2020.sales_2020 as projected_local
    FROM sales_2019 s2019
    JOIN sales_2020 s2020 ON s2019.mo = s2020.mo
),
with_currency AS (
    SELECT 
        p.mo,
        ROUND(p.projected_local * COALESCE(c.to_us, 1.0), 2) as projected_2021_usd
    FROM projected p
    LEFT JOIN currency c ON p.mo = c.month AND 2021 = c.year AND c.country = 'France'
)
SELECT ROUND(MEDIAN(projected_2021_usd), 2) as median_projected_sales_usd
FROM with_currency
